thread:
sarah.p: Quick huddle — we need to finalize GA acceptance for SLA, docs, monitoring, support routing, and pricing guardrails by EOD. Two asks: owners and measurable targets.

ajay.k: I can draft the SLA text and the automatic fallback policy. Will propose concrete SLO numbers.

sarah.p: Make them measurable: p95, p99, monthly availability, error budget, and an explicit rollback trigger.

marie.docs: I'll own the public docs + internal runbook snippets. Need example curl/SDK snippets for billing and diagnostics.

lucy_ops: Ops will own dashboards and alerting. Suggest metrics: request_latency_ms (p95/p99), success_ratio, queue_depth, batch_size_avg, kv_cache_hit.

ajay.k: SLA sketch: "99.9% monthly availability for hosted endpoints (requests counted at gateway); latency SLO p95 < 350ms, p99 < 1s for requests <= 2k tokens; monthly error budget 0.1%. Automatic fallback to a compatible model variant on region/instance degradation." I'll PR in 30m.

sarah.p: Add exception clause: no latency guarantees for customer-provided models or unreserved dedicated pools.

marie.docs: Docs matrix plan: one table for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (SLA, support response, telemetry available). I'll include a "Why my custom model isn't covered" FAQ and a billing example: `monthly_tokens * price_per_1k`.

lucy_ops: Alert routing proposal: Sev1 -> pager (oncall), Sev2 -> slack + email, Sev3 -> ticketing. Thresholds: p99 > 1200ms for 5m -> Sev2; error rate > 0.5% for 10m -> Sev1. Also add automatic fallback trigger at same thresholds.

ajay.k: Sounds good. I'll wire the fallback to scale down to smallest compatible variant and trigger rollback runbook. Need runbook link.

ops-bot: Created runbook: <https://internal/runbooks/ga-sla-rollback> (owner: lucy_ops).

sarah.p: Pricing readiness — finance needs a short unit-economics note and three example invoices (low/mid/high). Ben — can docs include those math examples?

marie.docs: Yep. I'll add three worked examples and a sample billing export curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/billing/export`.

sarah.p: Owners summary: SLA & fallback = ajay.k; Docs + billing examples = marie.docs; Monitoring, alerts, runbooks = lucy_ops. I'll be owner for the launch checklist item.

ops-bot: Launch checklist item created: `GA_SLA_DOCS_MONITORING_PRICING` assigned to sarah.p due 1745540000.

ajay.k: Target timeline: SLA PR by 2:30pm PT.

marie.docs: Docs PR by 4pm PT for copy review.

lucy_ops: Dashboards + alert config + runbook link by EOD.

sarah.p: If blockers, flag here and escalate to @lead-product. We'll do a 3pm sync to approve final wording. :thumbsup:

marie.docs: One minor ask — can we publish a short "what's covered at GA" changelog blurb for customers? Helps reduce support churn.

sarah.p: Good idea. Add a 2-paragraph blurb to the PR.

ajay.k: Uploading SLA draft now.

marie.docs: Starting docs PR, will ping for reviews.

lucy_ops: Will post dashboard screenshots once built.

sarah.p: Thanks all — let's close this out today.
